easy.def: Eggs mixed and cooked flat in a pan, then folded.
examples: Dad made an omelet.
I like cheese in my omelet.
The omelet is hot.

more.def: A food made of beaten eggs that are cooked in a pan and folded over a filling, such as cheese or vegetables.
examples: Dad cooked a cheese omelet for breakfast.
She folded the omelet in half and put it on a plate.
The omelet was full of tomatoes and spinach.

easy.def: A sign that something good or bad will happen.
examples: A rainbow was a good omen.
The black cat was an omen.
They saw it as an omen.

more.def: A sign that people believe tells what will happen in the future.
examples: Some people think a rainbow is a good omen.
The dark clouds were an omen of the coming storm.
In the story, a strange bird was an omen of trouble.

easy.def: Showing that something bad may happen.
examples: The dark clouds looked ominous.
The sky was ominous.
An ominous noise came from the cave.

more.def: Seeming to warn that something bad is about to happen.
examples: The ominous clouds told us a storm was coming.
An ominous silence filled the forest.
The cave looked dark and ominous.

easy.def: In a way that warns of trouble.
examples: The clouds loomed ominously.
The sky rumbled ominously.
The door creaked ominously.

more.def: In a threatening way that suggests something bad may happen.
examples: The dark clouds hung ominously over the town.
The thunder rumbled ominously.
The door creaked ominously.
Omit the last word.
She omitted a step.
Do not omit your name.

more.def: To leave something out, on purpose or by mistake.
examples: Omit the last word to make the sentence shorter.
She omitted a step in the recipe by mistake.
Do not omit your name from the paper.

easy.def: A book that has many stories in it.
examples: The omnibus is thick.
I read the omnibus.
An omnibus of stories.

more.def: A book that collects many stories or works into one volume; also an old word for a bus.
examples: The library has an omnibus of fairy tales.
He read an omnibus of adventure stories.
The omnibus contained all five books of the series.
